name: Climb@T3

coord_source.ref: https://customer-api.rezerv.co/v1/location (outlet latitude/longitude in the booking platform that powers climbt3.sg; no map embed on the page itself)

research_notes: Track C: the site is a JavaScript app, so the page text is empty, but its meta description (read from the page source) says climb and boulder for adults and children, managed by The Rock School. The site loads its contact data from the booking platform it uses; the outlet record there gives the address and the latitude/longitude used here (the airport terminal address was found only in that feed, not rendered as text). The airport operator listing shows current opening hours (Sun-Thu 11-20, Fri-Sat and holidays 11-21:30), boulder walls 2.5 m high and an 8 m rope wall. Primary page support for bouldering is only the meta description, so a reviewer may want a second look.
